verdict.rationale: Rive's docs say multiple people can work on the same file at the same time, with all changes tracked in Revision History and auto-saved, so simultaneous multi-user editing is a documented first-party capability. Live cursors, presence indicators, and instant real-time sync between editors are not described anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: live cursors/presence, documented real-time sync behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of multiplayer editing.

support.subject: As a designer, my whole team can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync

citations.quote: Even if multiple people are working on the same file at the same time, Rive tracks all changes and stores them in the Revision History.
Rive saves your files automatically as you work.
